test_suite: DanaRapay Source of Truth - 4 Safety Gates

gate_1_atomic_va_credit.name: Gate 1: VA Settlement Single Credit (Atomic)
gate_1_atomic_va_credit.details: First call credited balance, duplicate call blocked with ALREADY_PROCESSED

gate_1_2_withdrawal_atomic.name: Gate 1 & 2: Withdrawal Flow DanaRapay (Atomic + Idempotent)
gate_1_2_withdrawal_atomic.details: Create no debit, PENDING no action, SUCCESS debit once, duplicate blocked

gate_2_negative_balance.name: Gate 2: Negative Balance Guard
gate_2_negative_balance.details: Deduction blocked with INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, balance unchanged

gate_3_legacy_refund.name: Gate 3: Legacy Provider Refund (Idempotent)
gate_3_legacy_refund.details: First refund processed, duplicate blocked with ALREADY_REFUNDED

gate_4_callback_security.name: Gate 4: Callback Security (Audit Mode)
gate_4_callback_security.details: Callback audit middleware active, logging all requests

coverage: processOrderSettlement() - Atomic VA credit with idempotency
processWithdrawalBalanceDeduction() - Atomic debit with negative balance guard
refundFailedWithdrawal() - Legacy provider refund with idempotency
callbackAuditMiddleware() - Security logging for all callbacks
